name: stayfree-mcp
description: Unofficial StayFree screen time connector (MCP server) for Claude, on Cloudflare Workers

TIMEZONE.description: Your time zone in IANA format, e.g. `Asia/Vientiane`, `America/New_York` or `Europe/London`. Used to decide where each day starts.

MCP_SECRET.description: A long random string you make up (at least 16 letters and numbers). It becomes the end of your connector URL, like `...workers.dev/mcp/YOUR_SECRET`. Anyone with that URL can read your screen time, so keep it private.

STATE.description: Storage for the connector's device ID and your StayFree device group. Leave the default.
